children: FG Communities Holdings announced a corporate name change and Nasdaq ticker updates effective Sept. 28, 2026.
Filed Certificate of Amendment to change name to FG Communities Holdings effective at market open Sept. 28, 2026.
Common stock ticker to change from FGNX to FGC on Nasdaq, impacting trading symbol recognition.
Series A preferred ticker to change from FGNXP to FGCPP on Nasdaq, aligning preferred shares with new branding.
Company says new name reflects shift to owning and operating land-lease affordable housing communities.
